name: Exp_KPrmSt
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of two buffers from the custom KPrmSt indicator. It opens buy positions when the first buffer crosses above the second and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position management settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义KPrmSt指标的两个缓冲区交叉信号进行交易。当第一缓冲区上穿第二缓冲区时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持止损、止盈和仓位管理配置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于KPrmSt自定义指标的双线交叉趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当Ma1[1]>Ma2[1]（前一根K线第一缓冲区在第二缓冲区之上）且Ma1[0]<=Ma2[0]（再前一根K线第一缓冲区在第二缓冲区之下或相等）时，产生买入开仓信号，即金叉确认。卖出入场条件相反，为死叉确认。出场条件由反向交叉信号触发，分别关闭多头和空头仓位，同时设置了固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数(LOT)和保证金比例两种模式。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并通过BarsCalculated检查指标数据是否就绪。总体而言，这是一个典型的双均线交叉类趋势跟踪系统，逻辑简洁明了。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-line crossover trend-following strategy based on the custom KPrmSt indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] (the first buffer is above the second on the previous bar) AND Ma1[0]<=Ma2[0] (the first buffer was at or below the second on the bar before that), confirming a golden cross. Sell entry is the reverse — a death cross confirmation. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing crossover signals, where a bullish crossover closes short positions and a bearish crossover closes long positions. Fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) are applied to all trades for risk management. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size (LOT mode) and margin-based sizing. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, and checks BarsCalculated to verify indicator data readiness before processing. Overall, this is a classic dual-moving-average crossover trend-following system with straightforward logic.

parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制交易手数或保证金比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio for lot calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：固定手数(LOT)或按保证金比例
parameters.description_en: MM mode: Free margin/Balance/Post-loss margin/Post-loss balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平空头）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平多头）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号检测的K线编号

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于交叉信号的趋势跟踪，易于理解和维护
具备完整的止损止盈机制，止损1000点/止盈2000点，风险收益比为1:2
使用IsNewBar机制限制每根K线只计算一次信号，有效避免重复开仓
支持灵活的仓位管理模式，可选择固定手数或保证金比例
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，便于只做多或只做空的策略调整
pros_en: Clean and straightforward strategy logic based on crossover signals, easy to understand and maintain
Complete stop loss and take profit mechanism with 1000pt SL / 2000pt TP, providing a 1:2 risk-reward ratio
IsNewBar mechanism ensures signals are calculated only once per bar, effectively preventing duplicate entries
Flexible position sizing supporting both fixed lot and margin-based modes
Independent enable/disable controls for buy/sell open and close operations, allowing directional bias customization
cons: 依赖自定义指标KPrmSt，指标逻辑不透明，难以评估信号质量
缺乏市场过滤机制（如波动率过滤、趋势强度确认），在震荡市中容易频繁亏损
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等动态止损方式，在不同波动环境下适应性差
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不良信号
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，无法在趋势发展中优化仓位
cons_en: Depends on the custom KPrmSt indicator whose internal logic is opaque, making signal quality hard to evaluate
Lacks market filter mechanisms (e.g., volatility filter, trend strength confirmation), prone to frequent losses in ranging markets
Fixed point stop loss and take profit without ATR-based dynamic adaptation performs poorly across different volatility regimes
No trading session filter, may generate poor signals during low-liquidity periods
No position scaling logic (add/reduce), cannot optimize exposure during trend development
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或更高周期均线）以减少震荡市中的假信号
将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，提高对不同市场波动环境的适应性
添加交易时段过滤和点差过滤，避免在低流动性和高滑点时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Replace fixed SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for better adaptation to varying volatility
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid trading during low-liquidity and high-spread periods

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在不同波动率市场下可能不适配，高波动时止损可能过小导致频繁止损
缺少加仓检查，可能在已有持仓时重复开仓导致过度暴露
依赖自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA初始化会失败但无容错重试机制
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP may be misaligned under different volatility regimes — too tight in high volatility leading to frequent stop-outs
Lacks position check before opening, risk of over-exposure through duplicate entries on existing positions
Depends on custom indicator with no fault-tolerance retry mechanism — EA initialization fails if indicator fails to load
